releases.name: Save The President
releases.summary:
The bodyguard has only a few seconds to save the most important man in the world. Does he have what it takes?

Suit up, put on your sunglasses, and get ready for the most stressful job on the planet! In Save The President, you are a bodyguard tasked with protecting the President from imminent threats during public speeches and official events.

But be careful: react too soon and you could cause a national scandal. Hesitate for even a second, and the consequences could be fatal!

When a gunman’s laser sight appears in the crowd, the clock starts ticking. You’ll have only seconds to make the right move: leap heroically toward the podium, neutralize the gunman hiding in the crowd, or put yourself directly in the line of fire and take the bullet to save the President.

The future of the nation depends on your reflexes.

Save the President at any cost!

releases.name: Co-create Stories
releases.summary:
Create the character you want and live your own adventure.

Co-create Stories is a single-player AI text RPG where every line and action is entered in your own words. The AI game master responds to what you try and continues the story.

Bribe a guard to enter through the back gate. Fight, flee, persuade, betray, or try something no fixed menu could predict. Every adventure unfolds differently.

releases.name: Parkour Obby: Food Escape
releases.summary:
Parkour Obby: Food Escape is a fast-paced obstacle course where every level is made out of delicious food. Jump across giant burgers and parkour your way to the finish!

FEATURES:
>Food-themed parkour levels
>Checkpoints to help you keep progressing
>Hardcore Mode with all checkpoints disabled
>Challenging obstacles and levels

releases.name: Magical Craft: My Enchanted Dress Shop
releases.summary:
The story unfolds in the tranquil village of Frune. The protagonist, a young girl named Lilia, begins her journey as a dressmaker, using the “sewing magic” she inherited from her grandmother.

As she fulfills requests from the villagers and works toward becoming a legendary dressmaker, her everyday life of dressmaking begins.

With a friendly guide and simple controls, even children can enjoy the game with peace of mind.

releases.name: Aery - Calm Horizon 2
releases.summary:
This game is an interactive game experience that is designed to relax your mind and soul. You jump into the role of a little bird, explore beautiful landscapes and collect magical crystals that mark certain landscapes. 

Because there are no enemies or any other danger in this game you will be able to lean back and enjoy the scenery and the sensation of flying. It is a great game for relaxing and calming down after an exhausting day full of hassle. 

Of course, you can always select the level that you feel helps most to relax yourself. Most levels can be finished quite quickly so that you can freely choose spend time exploring the environment but you don’t have to stay for too long if you are just looking for a short moment of peace and enjoyment. 

This game features a collection of some the most beautiful sceneries from the Aery franchise. 
We hope you like them. So lean back and take a deep breath…

releases.name: Stone Run
releases.summary:
The ultimate test of reflexes and nerves!
A giant, unstoppable rolling stone is breathing down your neck, and there’s only one golden rule to survive: never look back!
Dive headfirst into Stone Run, a fast-paced, hand-drawn retro arcade experience designed for non-stop adrenaline and pure fun. Outrun disaster, dodge unpredictable obstacles, and push your reaction speed to the absolute limit in a beautifully crafted world that feels like an interactive cartoon.

releases.name: KAWAII PUSH
releases.summary:
KAWAII PUSH is a casual and relaxing Sokoban-style game in which players must push boxes to the correct locations.
The protagonist is a red-haired girl who explores cute and colorful anime-style environments.
With moderately challenging puzzles, the game offers a fun and accessible experience for players of all ages.

releases.name: Rooms
releases.summary: Rooms is an atmospheric first-person horror game in which an abandoned, dilapidated house becomes a puzzle in its own right. Search dark rooms, examine mysterious objects and solve mechanical and logical challenges to uncover the way to the final exit. Every door you open leads deeper into an interconnected labyrinth of clues, keys and hidden dangers.But you are not alone. The Gazer forces you to look darkness straight in the face, the Linger makes even safe hiding places more dangerous with every passing second, and the Harrow announces its deadly hunt with flickering lights and a rapidly approaching rumble. To survive, you must listen, understand the warning signs and act at the right moment.In Puzzle Mode, you enter different rooms and must solve the puzzles within them to progress. In Endless Mode, the house rearranges itself for every attempt: 100 rooms, wrong turns, stairs, brief interruptions involving keys and power, and an invisible presence that punishes slow progress. The timer runs until the final door, and your personal best time is saved.

releases.name: Same Time Tomorrow
releases.summary: A atmospheric visual novel about sleepless nights, quiet connection, and the girl who works the convenience store register until morning.

releases.name: MAMIO : Don't Fall !
releases.summary: MAMIO is a 2–4 player online co-op platformer where one mistake resets the entire team. Collect fart orbs, master your double jump, and survive chaotic obstacle courses together.

releases.name: Origin Hunt
releases.summary: A story-rich RPG with challenging turn-based combat and an absurd amount of control over how you build your party. Exploit mechanics, break the rules, and play how YOU want. Experience an emotional story brought to life by memorable characters. Terrible puns included at no extra charge.

releases.name: punkt
releases.summary: A online PVP multiplayer movement boomer shooter. Gain momentum around the map by using a mix of sliding and your weapons natural propulsion to boost you in any direction.

releases.name: GYROGUE
releases.summary: GYROGUE is a fast‑paced, physics‑based roguelike where you pilot a customizable spinning top through procedurally generated arenas. Master fluid momentum‑based combat, craft unique builds, and survive escalating waves of enemies and powerful bosses in an ever‑changing crucible.

releases.name: Mane, Tekel, Fares
releases.summary: How much of a human is left in you? "Mane, tekel, fares" is a classic-style text adventure game offering immense freedom of choice and multiple endings, based on the short story collection of the same name. Guide the fates of completely distinct characters across nine highly atmospheric stories.

releases.name: Painted Crowns
releases.summary: Descend into a shifting pixel-art dungeon where color is your weapon. Swap between red and blue, master fast top-down combat, and choose whether to kill or stun your enemies as rival Frog and Mushroom crowns fight for control of the living Ink.

releases.name: Saldyr: Before the Crown Fell
releases.summary: A 2D tactical RPG set in an empire on the brink. Lead your soldiers, exploit weapon matchups and break enemy morale. Eight chapters, solo or in co-op for two to three, with different endings shaped by the battles. Play in English, French or Italian.

releases.name: Monster Museum: Tidy Up the collection!
releases.summary: Step into the relaxing world of Monster Museum! Team up with your favorite creature companion and begin your journey to restore the museum by sorting 2614 monster figurines.  Unlock new abilities, collect badges and uncover hidden secrets along the way. Cozy, single player, no timers.

releases.name: Murmuring of Moth Mouth
releases.summary:
An account dead for eleven years uploads a video of Yuna's car from the road ahead. The girl in the clip is waiting at the next exit, and the job Yuna is driving toward has no record of her.

A short psychological horror VN about a road built from every future she begged for.

releases.name: The Vessel
releases.summary: The Vessel is a dual-character-controlled puzzle game with mind-bending, block-based puzzles to solve across 150 rooms.

releases.name: Only Straight Bros
releases.summary: Dive into Only Straight Bros, a hilarious 2-4 player multiplayer party game. Blend into the crowd, mimic your friends, and outsmart the deadly predator-bro in an absurd cruise ship survival showdown!
